title: Natuzzi
description: [AI generated] Natuzzi S.p.A. is an Italian manufacturer and distributor of furniture, specializing in leather and fabric upholstered sofas, chairs, and home furnishings. Founded in 1959 and headquartered in Santeramo in Colle, Italy, the company operates in the home furniture and interior design industry. Natuzzi designs, produces, and markets its products globally, selling through its own branded stores and third-party retailers across multiple countries.
